by
  intro E _ _ f γ a b hf hγ
  apply intervalIntegral.integral_eq_sub_of_hasDerivAt (f := fun t => f (γ t))
  · intro t _
    exact ((hf.differentiable one_ne_zero) (γ t)).hasFDerivAt.comp_hasDerivAt t
      ((hγ.differentiable one_ne_zero) t).hasDerivAt
  · apply Continuous.intervalIntegrable
    exact ((hf.continuous_fderiv one_ne_zero).comp hγ.continuous).clm_apply
      (hγ.continuous_deriv le_rfl)
